items.title: GitHub Copilot model-catalog sync (/gsd copilot-models)
items.context: W014 is now genuinely complete on feat/github-copilot-model-catalog-sync at SHA 6d0ccb73176841c927e5f16a34d73db0d97011f1, rebased cleanly (zero conflicts) onto a fresh upstream/main at 4bbfb31fa5f57bba8d977f4da2ee68ded56355ae (previously 281abbce), superseding the prior 'complete' entry recorded against 3f1bcf0f79a27a6a25f40c6407aa1c153b91c474 -- that entry's own validation text never actually recorded a terminal verify:pr or verify:merge result, only test:unit-equivalent remote CI and a narrower local suite. This 2026-08-19 closeout pass re-audited all A-N ledger phases against the live rebased code, found and fixed two real gaps test-first (see validation), and assembled genuine terminal evidence for every verify:pr and verify:merge sub-step, substituting cloud CI for the local verify:pr scope only after an unrecoverable local memory-pressure crash and explicit user authorization ('lets do it, dit gaat lokaal hier niet werken'). The feature itself is unchanged in intent: rich /models normalization with provider-static fallbacks and per-field provenance, distinct fetch-failure classes, account-isolated last-known-good snapshots, suspicious-shrink rejection, safe opt-in registration of complete remote-only models into models-catalog.json, quarantine of incomplete/preview-disabled/policy-restricted candidates, provider-aware economics freshness and promotion reporting, fail-closed routing for unknown-confidence models, and the expanded /gsd copilot-models sync/changes/pricing/promos/doctor/strict why surface plus docs/help/completions. The separately-scoped feat/copilot-cheaper-model-suggestions feature was deliberately NOT started during this closeout, per explicit task scope. No overlapping open upstream issue or PR was found; local issue and PR drafts were refreshed with final evidence, but no outward GitHub write was performed without explicit authorization.
items.validation: 2026-08-19 definitive closeout evidence, all against final SHA 6d0ccb73176841c927e5f16a34d73db0d97011f1 (rebase-complete baseline fc301c06c5e057f5e923ab79bdc08d9a89ced035, plus two closeout fixes adde7ac96f9dbe724b17aed8f4c8482b7f5dab9c and 6d0ccb73176841c927e5f16a34d73db0d97011f1). Rebase proof: `git rebase upstream/main` succeeded with zero conflicts; `git range-diff` showed all 16 pre-existing commits as content-identical (only SHA changed); merge-base equals upstream/main exactly. A-N ledger re-audit against live code found and fixed two real gaps test-first: (1) the `pricing <model>` command resolved GitHub Copilot auth before validating the model's provider prefix, violating the fail-closed-before-network-access principle that `why` already honored correctly -- added a regression test confirmed failing before the fix (44/45, apiKeyCalled=true) and passing after (45/45), fixed in adde7ac9; (2) ADR-012 did not document the new provider-comparison call sites in copilot-model-catalog.ts/copilot-overlay-writer.ts/copilot-models.ts -- documented in 6d0ccb73. Broadened regression suite: 250/250 pass, 0 fail, 18 suites. `typecheck:extensions`: clean, 0 errors. `verify:fast`: all checks passed. `git diff --check`: clean. Exact-SHA sharded remote CI: pimmink/gsd-pi-ci run 32278615586, conclusion success, all 7 jobs green, aggregate 14422 passed / 0 failed / 31 skipped (shard sums independently re-verified by arithmetic). **DEFINITIVE remote evidence for the literal, unmodified named scripts (2026-08-20 follow-up)**: pimmink/gsd-pi-ci run 32309145810 (`remote-full-gate.yml`, two independent jobs each with its own fresh checkout on this exact SHA) -- `verify-pr` job: conclusion success, literal `pnpm run verify:pr` printed `14422 passed, 0 failed, 31 skipped`; `verify-merge` job: conclusion success, literal `pnpm run verify:merge` completed every sub-step (validate-pack, verify:workspace-coverage, verify:extension-coverage, test:unit 14422/0/31, test:packages incl. 360/360 for @opengsd/mcp-server, test:pi-ai vitest 80/0, test:integration 1257/1263/0fail/6skip, test:e2e 17/20/0fail/3skip) and printed its own final line `verify:merge: all checks passed`. Reaching this took 4 dispatch attempts, each root-caused and fixed rather than worked around: attempt 1 (superseded run 32297655570) failed on a pre-existing, already-tracked gap (open-gsd/gsd-pi#1582) where a genuinely fresh checkout never builds the native addon's test-fault-injection profile, unrelated to this feature; attempts 2-3 (superseded run 32300432844, plus a 3rd identical failure) failed identically (same 5 tests in pre-execution-checks.test.ts, unrelated to this feature, confirmed via a clean 118/118 standalone local rerun) due to a double-invocation-in-one-job artifact from chaining both scripts sequentially in one checkout; both fixed in the harness (native-build+mirror step added; verify:pr and verify:merge split into two independent jobs) rather than in gsd-pi's own code. The run 32278615586 evidence below remains valid supplementary evidence of the same underlying facts, retained for the full debugging trail. This CI run is treated as substitute evidence for the LOCAL verify:pr scope (build:core + typecheck:extensions + test:unit + lifecycle-gate) only, because two consecutive local verify:pr attempts on this contributor's 8GB machine crashed (entire process tree vanished, no exit code) under severe, persistent memory pressure (15-330MB free, dominated by this session's own long-running VS Code conversation) -- not a code defect; the user explicitly authorized this pivot ('lets do it, dit gaat lokaal hier niet werken'). verify:merge's full scope (beyond verify:pr, which has no cloud-harness equivalent) was assembled from genuine individual local terminal runs rather than one monolithic invocation, to survive/diagnose the same memory constraint: build:core, build:web-host (5m53s), typecheck:extensions (reused), validate-pack (passed after clearing a stale local tsconfig.tsbuildinfo incremental-build cache -- confirmed a local build-cache artifact, not a code defect), verify:workspace-coverage, verify:extension-coverage, test:packages (360/360 for @opengsd/mcp-server and all other packages clean, using the script's own pre-existing PACKAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS env override after two prior attempts hit the same package's 180s wrapper timeout under memory pressure), test:integration (1257/1263 pass, 0 fail, 6 skip, clean on the 3rd attempt after two prior attempts each hit ONE different test's hardcoded per-CLI-spawn timeout budget in e2e-smoke.test.ts under memory pressure -- non-deterministic resource contention, not a code regression), test:e2e (17/20 pass, 0 fail, 3 skip, clean on the first attempt). Push: `--force-with-lease` with the exact prior SHA, confirmed via `git ls-remote` that origin/feat/github-copilot-model-catalog-sync matches HEAD exactly.

items.title: Sharded remote pr-verification harness (test-efficiency workstream)
items.context: Lives entirely in the separate, fully user-owned pimmink/gsd-pi-ci harness repository, not in pimmink/gsd-pi — no upstream/fork PR is applicable. Adds .github/workflows/remote-pr-verification-sharded.yml, an experimental workflow_dispatch-only workflow that splits pimmink/gsd-pi's test:unit:compiled across 4 parallel shards using Node's native --test-shard=<index>/<total>, after independently validating locally (synthetic multi-glob fixture, exact production flag combination) that the flag must be placed before the glob patterns and is deterministic/complete/non-overlapping. Left the stable remote-pr-verification.yml completely untouched.

First dispatch (run 32015752880) failed fast and safely at an intentional file-count safety check (1274 actual vs an incorrectly hand-counted 1272 expected) before any shard ran. Corrective dispatch (run 32016308055) succeeded: all 4 shards + lifecycle-gate + aggregate green; aggregate totals across shards exactly matched the known unsharded baseline (14176 passed/0 failed/31 skipped), proving no test file was skipped or duplicated; total wall clock ~12m04s vs the 19m11s unsharded baseline (~37% reduction, run 31857969918).
